about.title: About Us
about.content:
Welcome to our studio! We are dedicated to providing exceptional training experiences in a supportive and welcoming environment.

## Our Mission
Our mission is to help you achieve your fitness and wellness goals through expert instruction, personalized attention, and a community-focused approach.

## Our Instructors
All our instructors are certified professionals with years of experience. They are passionate about helping students grow and improve their practice.

## Our Facilities
We offer state-of-the-art facilities designed to enhance your learning experience. Our studio is equipped with modern equipment and comfortable spaces for all types of classes.

## Join Us
Whether you're a beginner or an experienced practitioner, we welcome you to join our community. Book a trial lesson today and experience what makes us special!

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.content:
A. Rental Guideline:

1. If interested, please call or whatsapp The Yard for further information about the usage of the studio and the rental price.

2. Rental Price: Minimum of 1 hour rental, after that half-hour session is allowed. For Overtime usage users will count as 1 hour rental fee. (15-minute rental time is not available)

3. We only accept booking within 3 months.

4. Quatation is needed for making a block booking.

5. Commercial shooting (Movie, short film, MV, advertisement ,etc which will be publish in social media) will be charged as Golden hour rent X 1.5 each hour up, and at least 2 hours booking should be made. For further information please contact us.

6. Due to the limitation of the floor texture, we don't accept heels dance at our venue. If there is any damage, a cleaning fee of $500 will be charged.

B. Basic Principles:

1. Time for venue preparation and tidy up are included in the rental time.

2. Certain amount of long tables and stools are free of charge, please request upon booking. The supply is subject to availability; The Yard does not guarantee the quantity of items we can provide.

3. If the function includes FOOD AND DRINK or other special function, a PARTY FEE HKD200.00 up will be charged. Please discuss with our staffs for further details.

4. The Yard does not inform users if there is further adjustment on rental change.

C. About Payment:

1. Users have to settle all payment before they use the venue. Receipt is upon request, please contact our staff.

2. If there is a need to change the rental time / date, users has to notify The Yard 24 hours before the original time. If the timeslot is not available and changes cannot be made, the payment can be saved for next time usage.

3. For general activity rooms or less than 4 hours seminar, please pay the rental fee 48 hours in advance. If the hirer cancels the rental of the venue, he/she must notify the company at least 48 hours before using the venue. If the hirer cancels the use of the venue within 48 hours, the hirer will also be required to pay 50% of the total venue rental. If the hirer notifies the company 24 hours before the use of the venue to cancel the use of the venue, the hirer must also pay the full rental fee.

4. If the rental time for training purposes exceeds 4 hours, half of the reservation fee must be paid 7 days in advance. For large-scale events, half of the reservation fee must be paid 14 days in advance, and a specified refundable deposit may be required before usage. The reserved seat fee paid is non-refundable under any circumstances, so guests are required to confirm the venue rental in advance. If you need to reschedule, the reservation fee can be used within six months.

5. If users are unable to use the venue because of typhoon no.8 or above / Black Rainstorm Warning, users can choose to change the date & time or ask for a refund.

6. If typhoon no.8 or above / Black Rainstorm Warning occurs during the booking period. Users are required to pay the rental fee as usual.

7. If typhoon signal no.8 or above / black rainstorm warning is on before our opening hours, The Yard will be closed. In general, The Yard will resume to duty within 2 hours after the typhoon/rainstorm signal is down. If the signal is down at 8pm or after 8pm, The Yard will remain closed. If the typhoon/ rainstorm signal is on during our opening hours, Members are required to stay in The Yard until it is safe to leave. Arrangements are subject to weather conditions, please contact us for enquiry.

D. Rules and Regulation when using the premises:

1. User must strictly follow the rules provided by the studio.

2. If the user doesn't comply with the terms provided, the staff has the right to cancel their booking on the spot and user will be asked to leave the studio.

3. Please return the studio on time. Rental Time includes preparation time and tidy up time. Overtime on use of studio will be charged.

4. Please maintain cleanliness at all times when using the studio. Trash are to be placed in a bag and dropped off at a designated area.

5. Any outside equipment that may need to be brought into the venue, users will need permission from the staff at the studio. All outside equipment must be dismantled and removed from the premises when booking time is finish. No outside equipment can be left in the studio when not in use.

6. Any poster or signage that would be put up in the studio will need permission from the staff. Please remove all posters and signage from studio when the booking time is over.

7. Any furniture or equipment that belongs to studio cannot be removed or dismantled without permission from staff. Everything must be returned to its original place before leaving the studio.

8. Licenses will not be provided by the staff. User will have to obtain these licenses on their own.

9. Smoking is prohibited within the premises.

10. Any form of gambling is not permitted in the premises.

11. Any dangerous firearms and illicit materials strictly not allowed in the studio.

12. Penalty charge will be held against the user if any damages occur within the studio.

13. We are not responsible for any loss or damage of any personal belongings/injuries. Insurance for the use of the studio will have to be provided by the user. The studio will not be responsible for any accident that occurs during the time of the booking.

14. User are not allowed to enter any restricted area or other areas that exclusively for staff only.

15. All activities that occur with the studio should abide by Hong Kong Law. The studio will not be responsible for actions of the user during the time of the booking.

16. The studio staff has the right to amend the rules and regulations of the studio at any given time and when it comes to relaying these regulations to the user.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our services.

## Information We Collect
We collect information that you provide directly to us, including:
- Name and contact information
- Payment information
- Class preferences and enrollment history

## How We Use Your Information
We use the information we collect to:
- Process your registrations and payments
- Communicate with you about classes and services
- Improve our services and user experience

## Data Security
We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

## Contact Us
If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact us.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our rental services, policies, and procedures.

1.question: What is the minimum rental period?
1.answer: The minimum rental period is 1 hour. After the first hour, you can rent in half-hour increments. Overtime usage will be charged as a full hour. We do not offer 15-minute rental periods.

2.question: How far in advance can I book?
2.answer: We only accept bookings within 3 months in advance. For block bookings, please contact us for a quotation.

3.question: What are the rates for commercial shooting?
3.answer: Commercial shooting (including movies, short films, MV, advertisements, etc. that will be published on social media) will be charged at Golden hour rent × 1.5 per hour, with a minimum booking of 2 hours. For further information, please contact us.

4.question: Can I wear heels in the studio?
4.answer: Due to the limitation of the floor texture, we don't accept heels dance at our venue. If there is any damage, a cleaning fee of $500 will be charged.

5.question: Does rental time include preparation and cleanup?
5.answer: Yes, the time for venue preparation and tidy up are included in the rental time. Please ensure you return the studio on time, as overtime usage will be charged.

6.question: Are tables and stools provided?
6.answer: A certain amount of long tables and stools are free of charge. Please request them upon booking. The supply is subject to availability; The Yard does not guarantee the quantity of items we can provide.

7.question: Is there an additional fee for food and drinks?
7.answer: If the function includes FOOD AND DRINK or other special function, a PARTY FEE HKD200.00 up will be charged. Please discuss with our staff for further details.

8.question: When do I need to pay?
8.answer: Users have to settle all payment before they use the venue. Receipt is upon request, please contact our staff. For general activity rooms or less than 4 hours seminar, please pay the rental fee 48 hours in advance.

9.question: What is the cancellation policy?
9.answer: If you need to change the rental time/date, you must notify The Yard 24 hours before the original time. For general activity rooms or less than 4 hours seminar: If cancelled 48 hours before, no charge. If cancelled within 48 hours, 50% of rental fee applies. If cancelled within 24 hours, full rental fee applies.

10.question: What happens if there's a typhoon or black rainstorm warning?
10.answer: If you are unable to use the venue because of typhoon no.8 or above / Black Rainstorm Warning, you can choose to change the date & time or ask for a refund. If the warning occurs during the booking period, you are required to pay the rental fee as usual. If the signal is on before our opening hours, The Yard will be closed.

11.question: Can I bring my own equipment?
11.answer: Any outside equipment that may need to be brought into the venue requires permission from the staff at the studio. All outside equipment must be dismantled and removed from the premises when booking time is finished. No outside equipment can be left in the studio when not in use.

12.question: Can I put up posters or signage?
12.answer: Any poster or signage that would be put up in the studio will need permission from the staff. Please remove all posters and signage from studio when the booking time is over.

13.question: What are the rules about smoking and gambling?
13.answer: Smoking is prohibited within the premises. Any form of gambling is not permitted in the premises. Any dangerous firearms and illicit materials are strictly not allowed in the studio.

14.question: What happens if there's damage to the studio?
14.answer: Penalty charge will be held against the user if any damages occur within the studio. All facilities must be returned to their original place before leaving the studio.

15.question: Is insurance provided?
15.answer: We are not responsible for any loss or damage of any personal belongings/injuries. Insurance for the use of the studio will have to be provided by the user. The studio will not be responsible for any accident that occurs during the time of the booking.
